findings.summary: The 1800 s complete-invocation boundary is not enforced through final publication/readback, and a just-over-boundary unit can remain marked complete.
findings.evidence: The inherited fitter cancels SIGALRM before its summary publication. New protocol.py lines60-62 call shared.publish without an armed inner timer, then lines81-85 sample elapsed before final JSON serialization/write/readback at86-89. An elapsed value below1800 followed by boundary-crossing serialization/write/readback retains complete status and read_unit accepts it. A blocked publication can continue to the1860s outer timeout.
findings.impact: A unit outside the frozen technical-completeness boundary can enter the six-unit inference.
findings.required_correction: Enforce the remaining inner deadline across all publication layers, check elapsed decisively after final readback, and validate timeout/completeness evidence in the reducer; add a focused clock/write-boundary counterexample.
findings.dm_response: Accepted. Correct before source acceptance or scientific execution, within the already declared complete-invocation-timeout scope. No frozen exposure or inference rule is relaxed.
